contract: Decode the same elementary input through Decoder::decode and the FFmpeg decoder. Compare geometry, syntax and dialogue level, CRC result and concealment flags, layout, service and matrix, and the reference downmix side data.

Kind 4 first holds syntax, bitstream ID, mode, LFE, dialogue normalization code, rate, samples, syncframe count, CRC validity, concealment, service and matrix. The codec-layouts records then follow. The reference projects the original dialogue code and CRC domain from its parser packets and takes concealment from the frame's error and corrupt flags.
Decode and output mixing are measured by the AC-3 and E-AC-3 rows of codec-workloads.
